project: TLA-Bench: An Execution-Grounded Benchmark and Counterexample-Guided Training Method for TLA+ Specification Generation by LLMs
note: Dataset construction is INTENTIONALLY EXCLUDED from this plan -- it is being finalized interactively. This plan covers everything downstream of the locked dataset.
goal: Publish at a top-tier venue. Three live targets, same core work, different framing: AAAI (neuro-symbolic / automated-reasoning framing -- arguably the most natural home), ICLR/ICML (method / empirical-finding framing), NeurIPS Datasets & Benchmarks (artifact framing, fallback).
thesis: A model checker is a uniquely rich oracle for LLMs. Its VERDICT (pass/fail via TLC) powers an execution-grounded benchmark; its COUNTEREXAMPLE (a concrete failing trace) powers a training method. Counterexample-guided training closes the formal-specification gap, especially on the temporal properties (liveness/fairness) where models fail most. One verifier, two uses -> a unified paper, not two stapled halves.
contributions: C1 Benchmark: first execution-grounded TLA+ generation benchmark (SANY parse + TLC model-check as ground-truth oracle), two tracks, contamination-controlled.
C2 Finding: strong LLMs largely cannot produce valid/correct TLA+; plus a CONSTRUCT-LEVEL failure map (which TLA+ constructs they fail on: liveness, fairness, temporal, PlusCal).

C3 Method (the novelty bet): counterexample-guided training -- feed TLC's failing trace back as structured feedback (CEGIS-style), not just the binary verdict. Distinct from RLVR / DeepSeek-Prover / unit-test RL, which only have pass/fail.
C4 Analysis (supporting, keep tight): hivemind failure-correlation -- are model failures complementary? Do small ensembles rival large models?
novelty_caveat: Plain 'verifier-grounded DPO for TLA+' is INCREMENTAL (RLVR / proof-checker-feedback applied to a new domain). The genuine novelty is exploiting the model checker's COUNTEREXAMPLE TRACE. src/preference_generator.py currently discards the counterexample (binary pass/fail only) -- that is the gap to fill.

tracks.A_translation: declarative description -> TLA+ spec. Exact behavioral grading (generated spec must SANY-parse and TLC-pass against the gold cfg). Gradeable NOW. Tests TLA+ fluency.
tracks.B_design: intent description -> TLA+ spec. Property-satisfaction grading (generated spec must satisfy the gold cfg's invariants/liveness, NOT match the gold text). Harder, deferred to Phase 3. Tests modeling ability.

grading: Execution-based via tla2tools.jar (SANY + TLC). Primary metric: unbiased pass@k (src/analyze_results.py). Secondary: structural F1 over parsed-JSON construct fields; surface similarity (contamination signal). Report with bootstrap CIs. NEVER text-similarity as headline.

phases.name: Baseline run (Track A) -- THE UNBLOCKER
phases.why: Every asset exists to produce these numbers. Cannot design the paper story until we see where models fail. Also gates whether Track B / the method are worth running (if no model clears the syntax bar, Track B is uniformly ~0%).
steps: 1.1 Wire a clean Track-A runner: description -> model (runner.py) -> extract TLA -> SANY+TLC grade (validator.py) on gold_system + silver_system (SANY-only where no cfg).
1.2 Run a representative ~5-model sweep first: span small->large (e.g. llama3.2-3b -> llama3.3-70b/qwen3-235b), reasoning (deepseek-r1) vs code-specialized (qwen2.5-coder), plus chattla base.
1.3 Analyze with analyze_results.py: pass@k by model x tier x system/utility; bootstrap CIs.
1.4 Build the CONSTRUCT-LEVEL FAILURE MAP: correlate failures with parsed-JSON construct fields (liveness, fairness, temporal, PlusCal, proofs). This is a differentiating analysis.
phases.deliverable: Scores table + construct-level failure map. The capability-gap headline.

phases.name: Counterexample-guided method + GO/NO-GO ablation
phases.why: The novelty bet. Its result decides ICLR-main (strong delta) vs NeurIPS-D&B (weak delta). Build EARLY before over-investing.
steps: 2.1 Capture TLC counterexamples: extend the harness to save the failing trace (TLC already emits it; corpus_health/review_triage parse it partially).

2.2 Counterexample-feedback loop: on a failing generation, feed the trace back ('your spec allows this bad behavior: <trace>') and have the model repair; collect (prompt, chosen=gold, rejected=fail, counterexample) tuples.

2.3 Train: SFT then DPO (src/sft_trainer.py, src/dpo_trainer.py). 'Chosen' MUST come from cleaned GOLD set; reuse copy_dependencies (roundtrip_fidelity.py) to actually verify chosen (fixes preference_generator.py's current chosen_passes_tlc=False gap).
2.4 GO/NO-GO ABLATION: counterexample-guided training vs verdict-only DPO. Clear+significant delta -> Path B is real (ICLR main). Small delta -> pivot to benchmark-only (NeurIPS D&B).
phases.deliverable: Ablation number (counterexample-guided vs verdict-only). The venue-deciding result.

phases.name: Contamination experiment -- THE PUBLICATION GATE
phases.why: Specs are public GitHub + LLM-written descriptions => high memorization risk. Reviewers WILL attack this. Turn it into a contribution.
steps: 3.1 MEASURE: verbatim-reproduction rate (surface_similarity already logged by roundtrip_fidelity.py).
3.2 MITIGATE via semantic perturbation: rename modules/constants/variables + re-bind cfg so a memorized regurgitation fails SANY/TLC but a CORRECT derivation still passes. Re-run baselines.
3.3 (Optional) post-cutoff held-out set: scrape repos newer than model cutoffs through the same pipeline.
3.4 Report the contaminated-vs-perturbed GAP -- itself a headline result and a reusable method for contamination-resistant evaluation in formal domains.
phases.deliverable: Contaminated vs perturbed performance gap. Validity argument for the whole benchmark.

phases.name: Track B (design) grading + run
phases.why: Enables the translation-vs-design contrast (a sharp finding). Only meaningful once Phase 1 shows some model clears the syntax bar.
steps: 4.1 Property-based grader: check generated spec satisfies the gold cfg's INVARIANT/PROPERTY/SPECIFICATION (refinement or invariant-holds), NOT exact match.
4.2 Run Track B (intent descriptions) across the models that cleared Phase-1 syntax bar; reasoning models spotlighted.
4.3 Report translation (A) vs design (B) gap.
phases.deliverable: Track-A-vs-Track-B gap. 'Models transcribe but cannot design.'

phases.name: Splits, human descriptions, full results
steps: 5.1 Train/test split BY REPOSITORY/STEM (not random) so spec variants do not leak across train/test. Current data/test_split.json predates cleaning -- redo.
5.2 Human-verified description subset (50-100): counters 'LLM-written descriptions favor LLMs'. Report human-vs-LLM-description performance.
5.3 Full baseline sweep (all models) + the fine-tuned chattla result; hivemind diversity analysis (keep tight, supporting).

phases.name: Paper writing + artifact release
steps: 6.1 Standardize + document the pipeline (data/dataset_manifest README, per-artifact schema, reproduction steps) -- a METHODS contribution showing rigor.
6.2 Reporting must-haves: separate system vs utility; per-tier; macro-average per repo (tlaplus+apalache dominate counts); gold (SANY+TLC) vs silver (SANY-only) explicitly distinguished.
6.3 Release: benchmark + harness + leaderboard format + model checkpoints.

go_no_go_decisions.question: Does ANY model clear the syntax bar (produce valid TLA+ at a non-trivial rate)?
go_no_go_decisions.no: Track B is uninformative (~0%); focus benchmark + capability-gap finding (NeurIPS D&B)

go_no_go_decisions.question: Counterexample-guided > verdict-only DPO by a clear, significant margin?
go_no_go_decisions.yes: method-led paper: ICLR/ICML main OR AAAI (method + neuro-symbolic framing)
go_no_go_decisions.no: benchmark/neuro-symbolic-led paper: AAAI (formal-methods framing) OR NeurIPS D&B -- AAAI still viable because its novelty bar is broader than ICLR/ICML

risks.mitigation: Phase 3 perturbation; report the gap as a result
lead with COUNTEREXAMPLE-guided (uses the trace), not plain verifier-DPO; prove via GNG-2 ablation

risks.severity: medium at ICLR/ICML, LOW at AAAI
risks.mitigation: frame as a REASONING / neuro-symbolic benchmark; cite production use (AWS, Azure, MongoDB); AAAI's formal-methods community treats this as a strength, not a liability -- a reason to prefer AAAI
quality over quantity; every spec verified + vote-classified; report construction pipeline as methods contribution

venue_strategy.principle: ONE core artifact + method; the FRAMING shifts per venue. Build venue-agnostic; choose target after GNG-2.

AAAI.fit: Strong / possibly most natural. Neuro-symbolic AI + automated reasoning + formal verification are core AAAI topics; CEGIS lineage is recognized and valued; 'niche TLA+' risk is LOW here.
AAAI.frame_as: A neuro-symbolic system where a formal verifier (model checker) is integrated into LLM training and evaluation. Emphasize: verifier-in-the-loop reasoning, counterexample-guided learning (CEGIS x LLMs), and real-world verification relevance.
AAAI.lead_contribution: C3 (counterexample-guided neuro-symbolic method) + C1 (benchmark) as the substrate.
AAAI.novelty_bar: Interesting AI contribution broadly; rigorous eval. Lands even if GNG-2 delta is modest.
AAAI.tracks_note: Main Technical Track (AI for software/verification, ML, KR&R, neuro-symbolic). Check current AAAI deadline/cycle.

ICLR_ICML.fit: Reachable only if GNG-2 shows a real, significant counterexample-guided delta.
ICLR_ICML.frame_as: A novel training method (counterexample-guided preference optimization) with the benchmark as the testbed; empirical-finding-forward.
ICLR_ICML.lead_contribution: C3 as a method paper; C2 (capability gap + construct map) as the finding.
ICLR_ICML.novelty_bar: High -- needs the method to beat verdict-only DPO (GNG-2).

NeurIPS_DandB.fit: Safe fallback. Artifact-first; rewards rigor + documentation.
NeurIPS_DandB.frame_as: The execution-grounded benchmark + capability-gap finding; training as a supporting 'what helps' section.
NeurIPS_DandB.novelty_bar: Lower on method; high on rigor/utility/contamination story.

venue_strategy.decision_point: After GNG-2: strong method delta -> ICLR/ICML or AAAI (method-led); modest delta -> AAAI (neuro-symbolic/benchmark-led) or NeurIPS D&B.
venue_strategy.recommendation: Default to AAAI as primary unless GNG-2 delta is large enough to justify the higher ICLR/ICML novelty bar. AAAI gives the best fit-to-risk ratio for formal-methods + LLM work.
